meta.title: How a deterministic infographic is made
meta.description: A five-step process from data and a JSON spec to a byte-identical SVG and PNG video frames, a comparison with image-generation models on reproducibility, editability and traceability, and the timeline of the engine's capabilities.

blocks.title: From data to a frame you can reproduce
blocks.subtitle: A spec goes in; the same SVG comes out, every time.

steps.title: Bring the data
steps.body: Open datasets with a source and a retrieval date.

steps.title: Write the spec
steps.body: Blocks, not pixels: hero stat, chart, timeline, locator.

steps.title: Measure the text
steps.body: Real font metrics decide every line break.

steps.title: Solve the layout
steps.body: Grid, safe areas and a fit loop; nothing overlaps.

steps.title: Emit SVG, then PNG
steps.body: 16:9 and 9:16 frames from the same bytes.

items.text: Text is drawn pixels and can be misspelled
No sources; numbers cannot be traced
Every glyph from a shipped font
Data provenance and spec digest embedded

blocks.title: What it does not do
blocks.text: It does not paint scenes. Illustration is drawn from a small icon set; a generated illustration can be supplied as a separate, labelled asset.
